title: Felix and the Salt
author: Lior Ravensworth
blurb: Vesper Eastwick, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
